findings.claim: 10-K 揭露：美國自2025年2月起依IEEPA及Section 232等授權加徵關稅，另有對中國的Section 301關稅；關稅成本可能無法完全轉嫁，供應鏈調整未必成功。
findings.excerpt: Since February 2025, the U.S. has also imposed additional country-specific tariffs on most trading partners, including China, as well as additional commodity-specific tariffs on certain imported items, in both instances pursuant to executive orders issued under various trade authorities, including the International Emergency Economic Powers Act and Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962.

findings.claim: 10-K 揭露：產品含加密技術，出口須政府授權；中國對鍺、鎵等材料實施出口管制（2025年5月起部分放寬），可能影響元件採購與成本。
findings.excerpt: Our products are subject to various export controls and because we incorporate encryption technology into certain of our products, certain of our products may be exported from various countries only with government authorization.

findings.claim: 最新10-Q（2026Q3）稱若關稅或非關稅措施升級，毛利率可能進一步受影響；產品營業成本含運費與關稅。
